title: China reserves right to take ‘necessary measures’ after Trump’s new tariff proposals
summary_full: Beijing says new levies amount to ‘political manipulation’, while Brazil ‘will not yield to this type of threat’Trump proposing new tariffs on 14 partners including China and EUBeijing has said it reserves the right to take “necessary measures” after Donald Trump’s administration proposed new tariffs on goods from China and other major trading partners, triggering a global backlash.Among the suggested levies on 14 major trading partners announced on Wednesday, China is potentially facing one of the biggest hits. It would face the highest capped rate of 20%, which in some cases will be stacked on top of other import taxes for a total rate of 45%. Continue reading...
